record.question: Streets of Aizawl are narrower than those of Delhi.
record.explanation: Answer C: Demonstrative Pronoun. Those stands for the plural noun phrase “streets of Delhi”; demonstrative pronoun (C). Independent check: “Those” substitutes for “streets” in “those of Delhi”; it points to a particular plural noun phrase and is traditionally a demonstrative pronoun. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/this-that-these-those. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
